title: Lacock Halifax Memorial
crew_summary: Crew — details not recorded in source
memorial_details: Church memorial, D-Day loss, in St Cyriac's Church, Lacock, Wiltshire.
narrative: Halifax MZ513 of 578 Squadron, coded LK-K, departed Burn at 0231 on 6 June 1944 — D-Day — to attack the Mont Fleury coastal battery. The aircraft was severely damaged by Flak leaving the target at 0437; engine fire and loss of control followed. 578 Squadron was the same unit that lost MZ519 at Farnsfield.
cause_of_loss: Flak damage — engine fire and loss of control on egress from target
operation_type: Bombing — D-Day, Mont Fleury coastal battery
notes: 578 Sqn link: sister unit to the Farnsfield MZ519 memorial, also a 578 Sqn loss.

sources.title: Chorley, W.R. — Bomber Command Losses Vol. 5
